newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia 91-day Bank Negara bills yield 6.343 pct.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia 91-day Bank Negara bills yield 6.343 pct.

text.p: Malaysia's central bank said on Tuesday it accepted bids at an average yield of 6.343 percent at its auction of 91-day Bank Negara bills for 500 million ringgit.
At its previous auction on February 18 for 91-day bills worth 500 million ringgit, the central bank accepted bids at an average yield of 6.337 percent.
The bids accepted were in a high/low range of 6.385/280 percent, the central bank said.
Bank Negara said it also accepted bids at an average yield of 6.439 percent at its auction of 30-day bills for 500 million ringgit. The bids accepted were in the high/low range of 6.462/399 percent.
Bank Negara bills are issued by the central bank usually to keep a check on liquidity. It also issues treasury bills on behalf of the federal government.
